speech.text: 10 Weird Things You Didn't Know About Zayn Malik First off, Zayn almost missed the audition that made him famous because he was too lazy to wake up at 4 in the morning. His own mother had to wake him up and convince him to go, or he might never have joined One Direction. Next, Zayn once claimed an alien spoke to him in a dream and made him realize he wanted to quit One Direction. After quitting, he walked around his hometown wearing his dad's coat, and people actually mistook him for his father. Even weirder, Zayn once took his sick pet chicken to a veterinarian and paid for an x -ray to try to save its life. The veterinarian laughed at him for bringing a chicken, and the bird later died in Zayn's arms. Next, Zayn was caught on camera nearly fighting a stranger outside a New York bar at 2 a .m. while completely shirtless. Just months later, he pleaded no contest to four harassment charges following an argument involving Gigi Hadid's mother. Next, Zayn tattooed his fiance, Perry Edwards, face on his arm, only to cover it after their breakup. Lastly, Zayn got kicked off Tinder because people thought he was using fake pictures of Zayn Malik, except it was actually him.
